output_list.criticism: This vulnerability is exploitable. A buyer could potentially buy more tokens than the available supply. The reason is that the buy function does not check if the amount of tokens to be bought is more than the available supply. The correct function should be: function buy() payable public {uint amount = msg.value / buyPrice; require(balanceOf[this] >= amount); balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount; balanceOf[this] -= amount; Transfer(this, msg.sender, amount);}
